analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (88,655 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (90,897 KRW / 104,615 KRW / 105,399 KRW): Below short/mid-term trend, indicating weakness.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 (114,661 KRW / 99,351 KRW): Below long-term trend, maintaining bearish strength.
· 52-week position (36.3%) + Current price level approaching historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (37.7 → 27.5): Oversold condition persists, confirming downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-774.3843 → -2514.6339): Worsening trend, confirming bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 87,606 KRW): Approaching lower band, with a band width of 32.52% indicating continued volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (82,710 KRW): Above 52-week low (52,365 KRW), based on Pivot S1 (77,758 KRW).
· Swing resistance (89,580 KRW): Below 5-day high (98,755 KRW), potential for short-term rebound if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High formation): Weakening signal continues.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.45x): Contracted compared to the 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to persistent oversold RSI and unformed ADX trend.
